# Metric Group

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MetricGroup`](gmeow-MetricGroup.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MetricGroup>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

One ordered group within a [`MetricStructure`](gmeow-MetricStructure.md), carrying a rational length and an optional accent weight. Additive meters are sequences of MetricGroups.
